en.title: Disney Lorcana Heroines Edition Sparks Chaos, Secondary Market Soars
en.summary: The highly anticipated Disney Lorcana Curator's Collection: Heroines Edition has caused a stir, with reports of chaos at a London Disney store. While official retail availability remains uncertain, the exclusive set is already commanding exorbitant prices on the secondary market.
en.body:
The world of collectible card games often sees moments of intense demand, but the recent launch of **Disney Lorcana's Curator's Collection: Heroines Edition** has reached a fever pitch, even spilling into physical chaos. Reports emerged of a significant commotion at a London Disney store as fans scrambled to get their hands on this special boxed set, which celebrates some of Disney's most beloved female characters. This edition features foil versions of iconic heroines such as **Ariel - Spectacular Singer**, **Elsa - Trusted Sister**, **Jasmine - Royal Seafarer**, **Mulan - Elite Archer**, **Anna - Trusting Sister**, and **Tinker Bell - Giant Fairy**. The scarcity and the immense popularity of these characters have clearly created a perfect storm for collectors and players alike.

While **Lorcana's** own blog post indicated that the **Curator's Collection: Heroines Edition** would be sold exclusively at select Disney Parks and Disney Stores with limited quantities, the reality on the ground proved more dramatic than anticipated. The scenes witnessed in Oxford Street underscore just how desirable this particular set is. For those who missed out on the initial retail frenzy or live far from these exclusive locations, the secondary market has become the only recourse. However, this availability comes at a steep premium, with prices soaring far beyond the original $99.99 MSRP. At the time of writing, listings on platforms like TCGplayer show prices around $400, a fourfold increase, demonstrating the significant markup driven by scarcity and demand.

## The Collector's Dilemma

This situation presents a classic conundrum for fans of collectible games. The allure of owning these unique foil cards, featuring characters deeply ingrained in popular culture, is undeniable. For many, it's about nostalgia, a love for the **Lorcana** game itself, or both. The **Heroines Edition** taps directly into this by focusing on characters who are not just popular but often represent aspirational figures for many fans. The frustration for those unable to acquire the set at its intended price is palpable. While some may choose to wait, hoping for a potential reprint or a price drop, others are willing to pay a substantial premium to secure these cards immediately. The high prices reflect not only the perceived value of the cards but also the current market dynamics, where limited supply meets overwhelming demand. It’s a testament to the enduring power of Disney’s storytelling and the growing influence of **Disney Lorcana** in the TCG space.

## What's Next for Lorcana's Limited Editions

With the **Heroines Edition** causing such a stir, the future release strategy for **Disney Lorcana** and its special sets will be closely watched. Fans will be eager to see if **Ravensburger** implements measures to improve accessibility for future limited-edition drops or if this pattern of high secondary market prices for exclusive content will continue. Details regarding any potential reprints or future distribution plans for the **Curator's Collection: Heroines Edition** have not yet been announced, leaving many collectors in a state of anticipation and uncertainty.

content_raw: One of the most beloved groups in Disney animation history is the princesses, and that popularity meant that the upcoming Lorcana drop, Curator’s Collection: Heroines Edition, saw a bit of a fracas at a London Disney store . While we’re waiting for an update on how fans can get the product in stores, it is available on the secondary market already. And, while the price is dropping from last week, it’s still considerably more expensive than it should be. Curator’s Collection: Heroines Edition Available From TCGplayer As you’d imagine given the Heroines tag, this boxed product includes foil versions of some of Disney’s most legendary princesses and female stars. Inside, you can find the following, with each card in foil: Ariel - Spectacular Singer Elsa - Trusted Sister Jasmine - Royal Seafarer Mulan - Elite Archer Anna - Trusting Sister Tinker Bell - Giant Fairy Disney Lorcana’s own blog post explains that the set will only be sold “at select Disney Parks and Disney Stores”, and that quantities are limited, but even they probably didn’t predict the chaos that ensued in Oxford Street. Still, the set is available online at TCGplayer , albeit at a steep, steep markup. While our advice would be to “Let It Go” and hope for a reprint, you can make it “Part Of Your World” for around $400 at the time of writing. That’s four times the $99.99 MSRP. We’ll leave the decision up to you, but it’s there if you’re keen. Maybe enjoy a period of “Reflection” before doing “The Next Right Thing”. OK, I'll stop now, honest. For more on Lorcana, be sure to check out our rundown of the Attack of the Vine set's most valuable cards.
